content: I am extremely disappointed with this foam mattress. After just a few nights, it started to sag in the middle and offered no support. Despite the advertised “cooling technology,” I found myself overheating and sweating all night. The chemical smell when I unpacked it was unbearable and lingered for days. It is much softer than described, making it difficult to get up in the morning. My back pain has actually gotten worse since switching to this mattress. Customer service was unhelpful when I raised my concerns. Overall, this has been a waste of money and I would not recommend it to anyone.
